end.parentNote: Asha practised animal diets, food-chain arrows, and what happens when one part of a chain is removed. Manav used examples such as grass and deer and correctly reasoned that fewer larvae would leave fish with less food. The arrow direction was still mixed up at the last seen attempt; at home, practise saying “food → eater” while drawing one chain, such as grass → deer → lion.
